purpose: Test whether temporally directed, entity-localized feature transport has causal leverage over physical event formation without training.

protocol.strength_distribution: total_strength divided equally across selected layers and semantic edges

controls.forward: source feature at frame t is transported to receiver support at frame t+1
controls.reverse_time: same semantic edge and mass, but source feature at frame t+1 is transported to receiver support at frame t
controls.same_time: same semantic edge and mass, but source and receiver are taken from the same frame

interpretation: A forward-specific behavioral change relative to equal-mass controls supports causal leverage of the routed pathway. It does not by itself establish a general physical law representation.
